weaknesses.title: ZIP/KEYS/VALS sep arg rejects bare string vars (unknown form)
weaknesses.detail: SYS ZIP bag_a bag_b SEP fails parse: unknown form 'SEP'. Same class as REPLACEALL with bare numeric vars. Sep must be quoted literal ":". Agents cannot pass CUBALC_AL_SEP through a var into ZIP third arg.
weaknesses.repro: LET SEP=":"; SYS ZIP a b SEP → unknown form SEP

weaknesses.title: UNION/INTERSECT/DIFF/DISTINCT/ZIP do not mutate named bags
weaknesses.detail: Must LET bag_a = LAST after every set op or WRITE persists pre-op bag. Silent footgun.
weaknesses.repro: UNION a b; LINES a unchanged without LET

weaknesses.title: UNIQ only adjacent — DISTINCT needed for full unique
weaknesses.detail:
UNIQ on api
db
api
mesh
db keeps 5 fields; DISTINCT yields 3. Agents still reach for UNIQ+SORT habit.

weaknesses.title: ZIP unequal lengths pad empty partner silently
weaknesses.detail: 4 hosts × 3 roles → last host: with empty role; extra roles become :role. No OK soft miss when lengths differ.

weaknesses.title: WRITE often omits final trailing newline
GREP still substring-unsafe on pure service names
weaknesses.detail: GREP api matches api_v2. Use HASLINE/COUNTLINE exact.
